title: 6 meeting ke baad Malhotra sir ne kaam ka jo solution diya... | Anhoni #shorts

characters.simran: Simran, an attractive stylish confident curvy young Indian woman in her mid-20s, natural hourglass figure, warm medium-brown skin, glossy voluminous wavy jet-black hair, tasteful glam makeup with defined eyes and soft lip, gold jhumka earrings; wears a stylish tan-brown formal blazer suit with matching trousers over a crisp white collared shirt buttoned up (modest neckline, no cleavage), a slim belt, company ID on a maroon lanyard; confident poised expression. Distinctive: tan-brown suit + maroon lanyard always visible.
characters.malhotra: Mr. Malhotra, late-40s Indian man, round stern face, medium-brown skin, thick black moustache, slightly balding with grey side hair, reading glasses low on nose, always frowning irritated expression; wears a light-grey formal shirt with a slightly tight dark maroon tie over a small paunch. Distinctive feature: reading glasses perched on nose-tip.

intro: POV: 6 meeting ke baad boss poochta hai — kaam kyun nahi hua?
music_prompt: light quirky corporate background music, deadpan playful-tense, minimal ticking-clock vibe, no vocals

panels.prompt: Over-shoulder morning shot, Simran at cubicle staring at laptop calendar packed with back-to-back colour blocks, coffee mug in hand, deadpan wide eyes; glass office windows, maroon lanyard visible.

panels.text: Bas 5 minute kaam ke mil jaate...
panels.prompt: Medium shot, Simran walking toward a glass meeting room clutching laptop and mug, sarcastic tight-lipped hope; blurred coffee machine and cubicles behind her.
Wide shot of glass meeting room, 5 people standing around a whiteboard, Simran leaning on wall visibly bored glancing at wrist watch; timestamp caption feel.
Meeting room shot, Simran slumped in chair, half-eaten lunch box beside laptop (laptop-lunch), glazed tired eyes; multiple video-call tiles glowing on screen.

panels.text: 4 PM — Meeting: agli meeting kab rakhein.
panels.prompt: Close-up on Simran's dead-inside deadpan face lit by laptop glow in dim meeting room, one hand propping her chin; blurred colleagues gesturing behind.
Simran back at empty cubicle at dusk, orange evening light, staring at untouched to-do list on screen full of unchecked boxes; office nearly empty behind her.

panels.text: Simran, aaj ka kaam kyun nahi hua?
panels.prompt: Malhotra leaning over Simran's cubicle wall, frowning with glasses low on nose, irritated; Simran turning slowly with disbelief, mouth slightly open, maroon lanyard visible; evening office.

panels.text: Din bhar to aapki hi meetings mein thi.
panels.prompt: Two-shot, Simran biting back the words with a fake-calm smile, side-eye at camera; Malhotra oblivious scrolling his phone calendar; glass office at night.

panels.text: Iska solution — kal ek meeting rakhte hain.
panels.prompt: Malhotra pointing confidently at calendar on his phone, satisfied nod; Simran's frozen open-mouth stare straight into camera, coffee mug mid-air; night office.

panels.text: Corporate ka ilaaj: kaam na ho, ek aur meeting.
panels.prompt: Bold punchline caption panel over Simran's defeated facepalm at empty cubicle, dark office, single desk lamp glow; clean screenshot-worthy text layout.

caption:
Din bhar sirf meeting, aur shaam ko sawaal — 'kaam kyun nahi hua?' 😮‍💨
Aur is problem ka solution bhi ek... meeting. Yeh loop kab tootega?
